refusal_closed: This is closed for now. Try again soon.
refusal_maintenance: The game is closed for maintenance. Try again soon.
refusal_friend_requests_closed: That trainer is not taking friend requests
refusal_not_walked: They have not walked anywhere yet.
refusal_too_many_chunks: Too many chunks asked about at once.
refusal_list_comparison: A list is only compared with in or nin.
refusal_gift_on_shelf: That gift is already on the shelf.
refusal_not_yours: That account is not yours to act on.
refusal_new_version: A new version of the game is out. Reloading.
gift_reason_starter: A first partner, for a trainer with none.
gift_reason_starter_balls: Something to throw at the next one.
honey_tree_description: Something lives in this tree, and it cannot resist honey.
honey_tree_refused: The tree will not take honey right now.
honey_tree_no_honey: You have no {item} to lather it with.
honey_tree_sticky: The bark is still sticky. Come back next window.
honey_tree_invite: Lather it with honey and see what comes down for it.
nest_heading: An egg, and whether you want to carry it.
nest_found_nest: An egg, warm in the nest.
nest_found_grotto: An egg, tucked away in the grotto.
nest_again_nest: One egg per player between refills, and you have had yours.
nest_again_grotto: You have already had what this hour hid here.
nest_bare_nest: The nest is bare until tomorrow.
nest_often_nest: One egg a player between refills
nest_commitment: Only your buddy can walk it warm, so taking it means putting down whoever walks with you now. What is inside stays a secret until it opens.
nest_egg_put_down: The egg you carry now is put down.
portal_description: A ring of standing stones, and a way through to any town's plaza.
portal_shut: The portal stayed shut. A key opens one, and only one.
portal_no_towns: Nobody has walked into a town yet.
stop_rocket_greeting: A Team Rocket grunt blocks the way. “{quote}”
stop_waves_off: {name} waves you off. Nothing more today.
stop_grunt_refuses: The grunt wants nothing more to do with you.
stop_unseen: Nobody named yet. Theirs are drawn once yours are.
gym_seat_description: A team left standing for the next trainer to fight.
gym_seat_taken: The seat is yours. Come back and defend it.
gym_seat_take_failed: They would not stand. Somebody else took the seat, you were just beaten off it, or nothing you picked can fight.
gym_seat_moved_on: The seat has moved on. Somebody else may be holding it now.
gym_seat_stood_down: You stood down. The seat is open again.
gym_seat_not_yours: It is not yours to give up.
gym_seat_win_value: The seat, and {stake}% of their purse
gym_seat_often: Up to {daily} gold a day · {left} left
gym_seat_barred: You were beaten off this seat. It is open to everybody else for another {minutes} minutes.
gym_seat_empty: Nobody is holding this seat. Leave a team standing and it is yours until somebody beats it off you.
gym_seat_defends: They fight for you while you are away, at full health every time, and nothing that happens to them is written back to your pokemon. What a beaten challenger pays lands in your purse.
gym_seat_carries: Your party carries the fight out with it. Theirs does not.
gym_seat_done: You have taken all this seat will give you today.
gym_seat_cooling: They have seen you off. Come back in {minutes} minutes.
safari_state_fled: It fled, and it will not be back.
safari_fed: Fed {item}. It is watching you now.
safari_no_ball: No ball of that kind to throw.
safari_description: One encounter, one throw at a time. A treat makes it easier to catch and every turn gives it another chance to bolt.
safari_bag_empty: Nothing in the bag to throw.
world_map_description: {span} chunks across, centred on {x}, {y}. Drag the map or use the buttons on it to steer.
world_map_steering_hint: Click it first: the keys go to whatever has the keyboard.
world_map_drag: Pulls the map along. The buttons in its corner step it too.
world_map_arrows: Pan one chunk. WASD does the same.
world_map_home: Back to the chunk you are standing in. C does the same.
world_map_rim: The camera is held inside the world, so panning at the rim comes straight back.
world_map_sky_hint: Washes each chunk in the colour of its weather, and rings the four worth walking to
world_map_quiet: Nothing out of the ordinary in view this hour.
world_map_canvas: World map, {span} chunks across, centred on {x}, {y}. Drag or use the arrow keys to pan.
board_egg_yours: Yours now. Walk it warm and see what hatches.
board_egg_gone: It is gone. Somebody beat you to it, or the window turned over.
board_elsewhere: This walk is being played on another screen, in chunk {x}, {y}.
walk_no_way_up: There is no way up within reach.
interact_done_with_you: Nothing here. This one is done with you.
interact_gate_elite: {who} only faces challengers holding all {count} {league} badges.
interact_gate_champion: {who} only faces challengers who have beaten all {count} of {league}'s Elite Four.
interact_gate_frontier: {who} only faces challengers holding the title of {title}.
interact_done_this_window: {who} is done with you this window.
interact_nobody_standing: Nobody is standing there any more.
interact_nothing_to_fight: {who} wants a battle, and you have nothing to fight with.
interact_grotto_egg: An egg, tucked away in the grotto. Walk it warm.
interact_lair_quiet: The lair is quiet. Nothing has come out this window.
interact_lair_need_pokemon: You need a pokemon of your own to raid. You can watch one already under way.
interact_too_late: Too late. The chunk has moved on.
interact_cache_empty: Picked clean. Come back next window.
interact_patch_bare: Bare bushes. Come back next window.
interact_tree_bare: Picked bare. Come back next window.
interact_no_seat: There is no seat there any more.
interact_nobody_passing: Nobody is passing through right now.
interact_no_way_through: There is no way through there any more.
challenger_rule_bare: Nothing is held: no items on either side.
challenger_rule_timed: Judged after {turns} turns: whoever has more of their party left standing takes it.
challenger_rule_curtained: A curtain is drawn as you walk in, and one room in {rooms} is kind: your three arrive poisoned, burned, paralysed, asleep, or mended. Hers arrive as they are.
challenger_rule_rented: The house lends both sides: pick 3 of the {offer} on the table and leave your own box alone. Nothing of yours is on the field, so nothing of yours comes off it.
challenger_rule_natured: Nobody fights on orders: every pokemon here picks by its nature, so a bold one guards and a brave one swings whatever the field asks for.
challenger_rule_countered: The house names nobody until you do: his 3 are drawn against yours the moment they are frozen, one apiece, so a team that covers everything covers nothing here.
challenger_rule_rolled: The wheel is spun as you walk in and it lands on both sides: a sky for the whole fight, every held item left at the door, everybody poisoned, or everybody mended.
challenger_rule_unhealed: The house keeps the medicine: nothing puts health back on your side for the whole fight, not a potion, not a berry, not a drain. Theirs heal as usual.
challenger_rule_singled: One of yours against one of hers, and hers is drawn against yours the moment it is frozen. Nothing can cover for anything else.
challenger_boss_wins: One of his six, a purse and the mark for {award}
challenger_executive_wins: One of the six, what they carry, a purse and the mark for {award}
challenger_grunt_wins: A purse, one of their spare three and the mark for {award}
challenger_elite_wins: Their purse and something from their bag
challenger_legend_wins: The mark for {award}, the largest purse and a rare find
challenger_champion_wins: The {title} title, the largest purse and a keepsake
watch_no_battle: There is no battle at this link.
duel_rules_hint_ceiling: Each limit is a ceiling. A pokemon fights with what it has, cut down to the limit.
duel_rules_hint_order: A list is cut from the top, so order a pokemon's moves, abilities and held items on its sheet.
duel_rules_hint_ready: Changing a rule takes both sides' Ready away.
duel_rules_hint_barred: A pokemon the new rules bar is taken out of its party.
duel_rules_description: What each pokemon may bring, and how many of them a side may field.
duel_rules_no_item_forms_description: A pokemon holding an item that changes its form, such as a Plate or an orb, stays out.
duel_rules_note: A ceiling, not an allowance: a pokemon fights with what it actually has, cut to this. Both sides lose their ready, and a party longer than the new team size loses its tail.
lobby_invite_failed: That invite could not be sent.
lobby_invite_no_friends: Nobody to call: add a friend first.
duels_intro: A battle between two trainers, arranged rather than found. It settles nothing: no candy, no aftermath, and nobody's record moves.
duels_no_lobbies: You are not in a lobby. Host one, or wait to be called in.
duels_seat_failed: That seat could not be taken.
duels_team_failed: That team could not be brought: one of them may already be in another lobby.
duels_seat_waiting: Waiting for a trainer to sit down.
duels_start_failed: The battle could not be started.
duels_invite_description: They see the call in their own Battle panel, and joining answers it.
duels_rules_failed: Those rules could not be set.
duels_blocker_ready: Both sides have to be ready.
battle_victory_trainer: {name} is beaten. They keep their party, and the purse is yours.
battle_victory_grunt: {name} is beaten. What was left behind is waiting in the overworld.
battle_victory_pvp: Their party is down. Nothing changes hands.
battle_victory_raid: The raid boss is down — it is waiting in the overworld.
battle_leave_concedes: Walking out concedes the fight: it counts as a loss, and what the party spent stays spent.
battle_leave_locked: The party stays locked to the fight until it settles or times out. Walk back into the lair to rejoin it.
battle_leave_description: Whether to walk out of a fight that is still going.
history_link_failed: The link could not be copied.
search_guide_description: A word finds a name. Everything else narrows.
search_guide_field: One field, one value. Terms narrow each other.
search_guide_refused: A term with a bang in front of it is refused.
search_guide_either: A bar inside a value takes any of them.
search_guide_number_before: A number takes a comparison, or a range:
search_guide_quotes: Quotes hold a value that carries a space.
search_guide_sort: Arranges the answers rather than narrowing them.
search_guide_offers: Start typing a field and the box offers the {count} it knows, then the values that one takes.
shop_prompt: Buy from the crate, or sell from your bag.
pick_catch_then_prompt: Choose one of your pokemon, then what to do.
pick_move_prompt: Choose one of the moves on offer.
pick_team_no_saved: You have saved no teams. The profile is where they are made.
pick_team_prompt: Tap to bring one, tap again to leave it. Up to {max}.
teach_failed: {name} could not be taught {move} just now.
teach_full: {name} already knows {count}. Choose the one it forgets.
teach_forget_note: {forgotten} → {move}. Only a level-up move comes back, and only from the Move Reminder.
learn_refusal_no_room: {name} has no room for {move}, and nothing it could forget was chosen.
learn_refusal_unpaid: What teaching {move} costs is not in your bag.
learn_refusal_unfriendly: {name} is not close enough to you yet to learn {move}.
learn_refusal_gone: Whoever was standing here has walked on.
learn_refusal_unavailable: {name} cannot be taught right now: it may be hatching, put away, or in a battle.
panel_notifications_description: Everything waiting on you, wherever it came from.
panel_profile_description: Your details, your buddy, your friends, your battles, your bids and your trades.
panel_raids_description: Every lobby still gathering in the current window.
panel_auctions_description: What is up for auction, and what you have to sell.
panel_boxes_description: Every pokemon you have caught, filed into boxes.
panel_pokedex_description: Every pokemon there is, and how many of them you have met.
panel_gifts_description: What the game is holding for you, until you come for it.
panel_quests_description: What the game asks of you, and what each ask pays.
panel_battle_description: The private fights you have been called into, and the one you are hosting.
panel_settings_description: How the game is set up for you, and what it is made of.
panel_news_description: What the game has shipped, newest first.
banned_no_reason: Nothing else was said about it.
landing_tagline: A world grown from a seed, and real-time battles in it.
menu_windows_note: Counted off your own clock, so nothing turns over halfway through what you are doing at it.
login_step_backup: One more step: a backup code.
login_step_app: One more step: the code from your authenticator app.
toast_seat_freed_gold: You beat them off it. +{amount} gold
toast_seat_held: Their line-up held. The seat stays theirs.
settings_dark_mode_description: Draws the game in its night colours. Follows your machine until you choose.
settings_reduce_motion_description: Holds the decoration still: fades, transitions, and the idle a pokemon breathes at. Walking, battles and eggs still move.
settings_grid_lines_description: Rules a line round every cell of the board.
settings_chunk_lines_description: Rules a line where one chunk of the world meets the next.
settings_map_grid_description: Rules every chunk on the world map, the detailed map as well.
settings_flat_board_description: Draws the board flat from straight above on a wide screen too, the way an upright screen always shows it.
settings_detailed_map_description: Draws water, cliffs, towns and routes on the map, and takes a moment to fill in. Off, the map shows each chunk's country at once, with towns picked out.
settings_keep_ball_description: A meeting opens on whatever ball you last threw, where you still carry one. Off, every meeting opens on a Poke Ball.
settings_sound_description: What the world says in passing, a shiny sparkling among it.
settings_step_highlight_description: Tints cliff tiles red and seamed tiles green on the board.
settings_shiny_boost_description: Rolls about half of all spawns shiny. Off, spawns roll at the real odds.
settings_clock_24h_description: Twenty past eight in the evening is 20:20.
settings_edge_haze_description: The country fades into the sky toward the edge.
settings_edge_full_description: The ground reaches every corner of the screen. Heavier to draw.
settings_edge_plain_description: The board stops at its edge, with the sky past it.
settings_box_five_description: 25 to a box, and the largest squares.
settings_box_six_description: 30 to a box, the way the games lay one out.
settings_box_eight_description: 40 to a box, for sweeping a long collection.
settings_control_menu: Puts the keyboard on the bar along the bottom.
settings_controls_note: The arrows always walk, whatever these say. Read while nothing else on the page has the keyboard, so a key typed into a search box is a key typed into a search box.
settings_audio_note: Music is kept for when there is some. Sound is what the world does now.
settings_about_dex: Gens 1 to {newest}, {count} species, with the newest rules wherever generations disagree
settings_about_game: A Pokemon-style overworld you walk through, generated as you go. The map is never stored: one seed produces the climate, the climate sorts into biomes, and each chunk rolls its own landmarks, spawns, stashes and raids from that seed plus the clock. Two players standing in the same place at the same time compute the same world without exchanging any of it.
settings_about_license: MIT licensed, except the art and the names
settings_about_not: Overwander is a fan project. Pokemon is a trademark of Nintendo, Creatures Inc. and GAME FREAK Inc., and The Pokemon Company owns the franchise. None of them is affiliated with this project, has endorsed it, or has seen it. The species, moves, abilities, items and type chart are theirs. Nothing here is sold, and nothing here is offered as an official product.
credits_sprites_note: Everybody named on a sheet that ships, and the pokemon they drew.
credits_scenery_note: Names alone: which of them drew which tile was never written down.
security_backup_note: Keep these somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if the app is lost.
security_totp_on: Signing in with a password also asks for the app's code.
security_totp_offer: Ask for a code from an authenticator app whenever you sign in with a password.
security_totp_scan: Scan this with the app, or type the key into it, then enter the code it shows.
security_passkeys_note: Sign in with this device's fingerprint, face or PIN, or a security key, with no password.
security_no_password: This account has no password yet. Ask staff for a password link.
security_confirm_note: Type your password to change how this account signs in.
security_refusal_backup_codes: Could not make new backup codes.
notices_line_auction_won: You won a lot. It is waiting to be collected.
notices_line_auction_unsold: Nobody bid on your lot. Take it back.
notices_line_auction_outbid: You have been outbid, and it is still open.
notices_empty: Nothing is waiting on you. Invitations and offers land here.
news_empty: Nothing has shipped yet. There will be a page here when it does.
gifts_gone: That gift is no longer waiting.
gifts_failed: That gift could not be taken.
gifts_offered_pokemon: No pokemon have been offered yet.
gifts_waiting_pokemon: No pokemon are waiting for you.
gifts_offered_items: No items have been offered yet.
gifts_waiting_items: No items are waiting for you.
gifts_offered_meetings: No meetings have been offered yet.
gifts_waiting_meetings: No meetings are waiting for you.
friends_your_code: Your code, for others to add you by
friends_add_description: Share your code to be added, or look a trainer up by theirs. Asking somebody who has already asked you makes the friendship at once.
friends_empty: Nobody yet. Add a friend by their code.
friends_blocked: Blocked. They cannot ask you, and you cannot ask them.
friends_no_requests: Nobody has asked to be your friend.
auth_refusal_wrong_password: That email and password do not match.
auth_refusal_account_exists: There is already an account with that email.
auth_refusal_invalid_email: That is not an email address.
auth_refusal_invalid_token: This link has been used or has expired. Ask staff for a new one.
auth_refusal_invalid_backup_code: That backup code is not right, or was used already.
auth_refusal_two_factor_expired: That took too long. Sign in again.
auth_refusal_locked: Too many wrong codes. Wait a while and try again.
auth_refusal_too_many_codes: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
auth_refusal_too_many: Too many tries. Wait a moment and try again.
auth_refusal_fallback: Could not sign you in just now.
auth_refusal_passkey: That passkey did not sign you in.
auth_refusal_sign_out: Could not sign you out just now.
reset_mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
reset_no_token: This link is missing its token. Ask staff for a new one.
reset_done_after: with your account's email and this password.
catch_take_back_gone: That one has already gone for good.
catch_take_back_no_candy: The candy it paid has been spent, so it cannot come back.
catch_let_go_note: Each can still come back today, for the candy it paid.
catch_buddy_refused: That one cannot walk with you right now.
catch_buddy_none_theirs: Nobody is walking with this trainer.
catch_buddy_none: Nobody is walking with you. A buddy draws pokemon in, earns the candy and is the only thing that hatches an egg.
catch_buddy_empty: You have nothing to walk with yet.
catch_box_label: Box of pokemon, {filled} of {count} squares filled.
catch_box_make_failed: The box could not be made.
catch_box_new_note: Name it and pick a colour. This pokemon goes in it.
catch_cap_failed: The {item} could not be used. The stat may already be perfect, or you may no longer have one.
catch_cap_description: Raises one value to {max}. Choose which, since nothing takes it back.
catch_patch_failed: The patch could not be used — it may already keep its signature, or you may no longer have one.
catch_patch_no_signature: Its family has no signature to write.
catch_patch_room: It has a slot standing empty, so nothing is given up.
catch_patch_description: A signature cannot be taken back off. Where there is no room for it, choose the ability it takes the place of.
catch_pp_failed: {item} could not be used — the move may already carry everything it will take, or you may no longer have one.
catch_pp_no_moves: It knows nothing to spend it on.
catch_pp_all_full: Every move it knows is already full.
catch_pp_description: {item} is spent on one move, and nothing takes the points back. Choose the move it goes on.
catch_picker_picks_stay: Picks made in other boxes stay picked while you look at this one.
catch_picker_choose_up_to: Choose from your pokemon — up to {count} of them.
catch_picker_failed: Could not read your pokemon just now. Try again in a moment.
catch_give_empty: Nothing in the bag can be held.
catch_heading_picking: Press to pick. Shift-press picks a run, and picks carry across boxes and searches.
catch_heading_picking_place: Then press an empty square to put them there.
catch_heading_default: {count} pokemon. Anything not filed in a box waits here, and new catches land here first.
catch_heading_lay_out_hint: Puts each pokemon in the slot of its number
catch_heading_close_up_hint: Slides everything forward, keeping its order
catch_heading_delete_ask: Delete {name}? Its {count} pokemon go back to Default.

match.countPlural=one: {count} held item comes back to the bag.
match.countPlural=*: {count} held items come back to the bag.

catch_rail_counting: While searching all boxes, each count is how many match there.
catch_rail_drag_picked: Or drag the {count} onto a box.
catch_rail_drag: Drag a pokemon onto a box to file it.
catch_empty_card_note: Add pokemon from any box, drag some onto {name} in the list, or move them here from their sheet.
catch_found_note: Each square says which box it lives in
catch_slot_order_note: Slot order keeps the gaps. Any other order lists the box packed, gaps hidden. The box always ends in one empty row to place into, and grows as you fill it.
catch_press_note: Press a pokemon to open its sheet
catch_long_press_note: Long-press a pokemon to start picking
catch_add_to_note: Pick from any of your boxes. They are filed in the order picked.
catch_met_fateful_at: Met in a fateful encounter at {place}.
catch_evolve_not_possible: This evolution is not possible here.
catch_evolve_covered: The handover it asked for is done. This evolution is ready.
catch_stats_help_iv: IVs are what it was born with, from 0 to {max}. They never change.
catch_stats_help_ev: EVs are trained in. It earns {level} points a level to spend in this table. A stat takes at most {max}.
catch_stats_help_items: Wings add {wing} and vitamins add {vitamin} to one stat, on top of the level points rather than out of them.
catch_stats_help_berries: Some berries take effort back out of a stat, so it can be spent again.
catch_stats_help_nature: The nature raises one stat by 10% (▲) and lowers another by 10% (▼).
catch_stats_help_bars: Each bar is measured against this pokemon's best stat.
catch_slot_unlock_ability: The Channeler opens another when she calls up an ability.
catch_slot_unlock_move: The Dojo Master opens another for a {item}.
catch_abilities_help_room: A pokemon has room for {start} ability to start, and up to {max}.
catch_abilities_help_items: An {capsule} draws another ability its line can reach. An {patch} writes in its family's signature ability.
catch_abilities_help_channeler: The Channeler, a wandering NPC, calls up another ability its line can reach and adds a slot for it. She charges one {fee} and helps once each time she appears.
catch_abilities_help_order: Drag to reorder. A fight that allows fewer abilities takes them from the top.
catch_held_items_help_room: A pokemon holds {start} item to start. A {belt} adds a slot for good, up to {max}.
catch_held_items_help_give: Press an empty square to give an item from the bag. Hover an item to take it back.
catch_held_items_help_order: Drag to reorder. A fight that allows fewer items takes them from the top.
catch_moves_help_room: A pokemon knows up to {start} moves to start, and never more than {max}.
catch_moves_help_order: Drag to reorder, or hold Alt and press the arrows. A fight that allows fewer moves takes them from the top.
catch_moves_help_pp: PP is how quickly a move comes back after use, not a count that runs out. PP Ups raise it for good.
catch_moves_help_speed: Speed shortens every cooldown. Hover a move to see its wait for this pokemon.
catch_candy_failed: That candy could not be used.
catch_order_failed: That order could not be saved.
catch_train_failed: Those points could not be moved.
catch_evolution_gone: That evolution is no longer available.
catch_evolved_husk: Evolution complete. A {name} was left behind.
catch_name_draft_species: It will go back to being called by its species.
catch_name_draft_back: It will go back to being called {name}.
catch_name_failed: That name could not be given.
catch_name_cleared: Its name is its own again.
catch_favorited: Kept — it cannot be released, auctioned or traded.
catch_locked: Locked — it will be left alone.
catch_released_items: What it was holding is back in the bag.
catch_release_blocked_raid: It is in a raid, so it cannot be released.
catch_release_blocked_only: The only pokemon you have cannot be released.
catch_release_blocked_favorite: A favorite cannot be released. Unfavorite it first.
catch_release_blocked_locked: A locked pokemon cannot be released. Unlock it first.
catch_sheet_description_theirs: One pokemon in full, as it stands. Nothing here can be changed, since it is not yours.
catch_sheet_description: One pokemon in full: what it is, what it is carrying, and what can be done to it.
catch_egg_progress_idle: {steps} / {hatch} steps. It only moves while it is the one being carried.
catch_history_description: Everyone who has owned this pokemon, oldest first.
catch_release_graced: It can be taken back within a day, for the candy it paid.
catch_release_final: Letting a pokemon go cannot be undone.
catch_release_pays: {name} will be let go for {candy} candy.
catch_release_returns: What it is holding comes back to the bag: {items}.
catch_name_description: What you call it. Left empty, it goes back to being called by its species.
catch_warn_patch: A signature cannot be taken back off, and neither can the ability it replaces.
catch_warn_purify: Purifying cannot be undone. The Shadow ability goes for good, and it stops being a shadow.
catch_use_empty: Nothing in the bag would do it any good.
catch_fold_description: It goes inside the {name} until you take the two apart again.
item_spent_gigantamax: It carries the Gigantamax Factor now.
item_spent_tera_short: It takes {count} {item}s to change a Tera type.
item_spent_effort: {item} — points it did not have to earn.
item_spent_berry: Bitter, and good for it — {count} points back to spend, and it thinks the better of you.
item_candy_description: {count} in the jar. It raises anything of that family, and letting one go pays more of it.
item_bag_help_use: Press an item you can use to pick the pokemon to use it on.
item_bag_help_medicine: Medicine heals and cures. Poke Balls are thrown at wild pokemon.
item_bag_help_held: Held items are given to a pokemon from its sheet.
item_bag_help_machines: Machines teach a move, and evolution items evolve the pokemon that need them.
item_bag_help_training: Training items change a pokemon's values or effort.
item_bag_help_fossils: Fossils are revived by the Fossil Scientist, and valuables are only worth selling.
item_bag_help_candies: Candies belong to a family. Every pokemon in that line spends the same pile to level up, and releasing one gives some back.
item_relic_no_place: Take a walk first: a relic is used where the player is standing.
item_rope_refused: A rope is for the dark, and there is no way up within reach.
item_rope_used: Up the rope, and out into the light.
item_use_on_empty: You have nothing to use it on.
item_picker_empty: Nothing in the bag for this.
item_picker_choose_many: Choose what to take out of the bag, and how many of each.
item_picker_choose_one: Choose one thing out of the bag.
dex_coat_unmet: A pokemon nobody has met yet
dex_forms_description: Every form this pokemon comes in. Open one for its own entry.
dex_find_placeholder: A number, or the name of one you have met
dex_entry_description: One species in full: what it is, where it lives, and everything it can learn.
dex_line_help_hover: Hover a stage to see what it takes to evolve into it.
dex_line_help_press: Press a stage to open its entry.
dex_line_help_unmet: A stage you have not met is a silhouette.
dex_meet_first: Meet this pokemon to fill in its entry.
dex_base_stats_help_start: What every one of this species starts from, before level and training.
dex_base_stats_help_own: A caught pokemon's own stats also depend on its IVs, its EVs and its nature.
dex_base_stats_help_bars: Bars are measured against {max}, so species can be compared at a glance.
dex_abilities_help_born: A pokemon is born with one of the grey abilities.
dex_abilities_help_hidden: Blue ones are hidden: rarer, but a birth can still roll one.
dex_abilities_help_signature: Gold is the family's signature ability. Nothing rolls it; an {patch} writes it in.
dex_abilities_help_more: An {capsule} or the Channeler adds another ability the line can reach.
dex_habitat_help_biomes: Each biome it appears in, with the times of day it is out.
dex_habitat_help_towns: Towns list the hours it walks their streets.
dex_habitat_help_lairs: A legendary waits in its lair rather than roaming.
dex_habitat_none: It is not met in the wild.
dex_extinct: Extinct. It is only ever met by reviving a {fossils}.
dex_moves_help_level: Level moves are offered as it levels up.
dex_moves_help_machines: Machines are taught from the bag or by the Move Tutor.
dex_moves_help_egg: Egg moves are only inherited, from parents at the Breeder.
dex_moves_help_hover: Hover a move to see what it does.
dex_moves_none_machines: Nothing can be taught to it.
auction_refusal_dear: {amount} gold is more than you hold
auction_bid_description: The floor is the seller's least raise. Anything from there to what you are holding is a legal bid, so a lot can be put out of reach in one press.
auction_bid_meta: {floor} gold to take it · you hold {gold}
auction_bid_failed: That bid could not be placed.
auction_bid_placed: Bid {amount} gold — it is yours unless somebody raises it.
auction_collect_failed: That lot could not be collected.
auction_take_back_failed: That lot could not be taken back.
auction_hint_duration: An auction runs for {hours} hours, and you can run one at a time.
auction_hint_catches: A pokemon can be sold if it is shiny, has perfect or all-zero IVs, or is a legendary or mythical. A favourite cannot be sold.
auction_hint_items: Only special items can be sold.
auction_hint_unsold: A lot nobody bids on does not come back on its own. Collect it from Profile, Market, Selling.
auction_running: You have an auction running — {remaining}. One at a time, which is one a day.
auction_bag_empty: Nothing in the bag is rare enough for the block.
auction_records_empty: Nothing of yours is rare enough for the block.
auction_put_up_failed_item: It could not be put up — you may already have an auction running, or no longer carry one.
auction_put_up_failed_catch: It could not be put up — you may already have an auction running, or it may be a favorite, an egg or your buddy.
auction_description: What it opens at, and the least a bid may raise it by. A lot stands for a day.
auction_confirm_description: It leaves your records the moment the lot opens.
auction_confirm_item: Opening at {asking} gold, raised {raise} at a time. It stands for a day and cannot be taken back off the block — it comes back only if the day ends with nobody having bid. One piece goes up, not the stack.
auction_confirm_catch: Opening at {asking} gold, raised {raise} at a time. It stands for a day and cannot be taken back off the block — it comes back only if the day ends with nobody having bid. It goes up held items and all.
auction_confirm_payment: Whoever wins it pays what they bid; the gold is yours when they collect it.
auction_put_up_day: Put it up for a day
auction_no_bids: You have not bid on anything.

match.countPlural=one: One lot came back unsold and is waiting for you to take it.
match.countPlural=*: {count} lots came back unsold and are waiting for you to take them.

auction_none_listed: You have not put anything on the block.
auction_selling_note: One lot at a time, and it runs for a day. New listings are made at an auction board.
trade_offer_failed: The offer could not be made.
trade_description: Your pokemon goes to them the moment they accept, and theirs comes to you. An offer holds your pokemon until it is answered or taken back.
trade_gold_taken_now: Taken when the offer is sent · you hold {gold}
trade_gold_taken_later: Taken from them when they accept
trade_ask_note: A named ask is exactly what comes back; leave it to their pick and they choose.
trade_your_side_description: Choose the pokemon to offer. It is held the moment the offer is sent.
trade_their_side_description: Name the one you are asking for. It is what crosses back if they accept.
trade_closed: That trade is no longer open.
trade_nobody_offering: Nobody is offering you anything right now.
trade_waiting: Waiting on an answer. The pokemon is held until they give one.
trade_answer_description: Choose the pokemon to give back. Picking it agrees to the trade.
raid_none_gathering: No raids are gathering right now.
raid_kind_mythical: Starting the raid spends the relic that called it, and it happens once, won or lost.
raid_kind_shadow: A shadow raid: what it leaves behind is stronger and costs twice the candy to raise.
raid_kind_totem: A Totem raid: it starts boosted and calls an ally at half HP. Beaten, it leaves a Z-Crystal and waits at Totem size.
raid_kind_gigantamax: A Max Raid: it is Gigantamaxed for the whole fight. Beaten, it leaves Max Mushrooms and keeps its Gigantamax Factor when caught.
raid_kind_dynamax: A Max Raid: it is Dynamaxed for the whole fight. Beaten, it leaves Max Mushrooms, and now and then a Dynamax Band.
raid_kind_noble: A Noble raid: its HP is its Frenzy, and it staggers at 3/4, 1/2 and 1/4 and bursts on the whole party in between. Calmed, it leaves Balms and gold rather than waiting to be caught. Each player packs up to 3 Balms from their bag.
raid_kind_tera: A Tera raid: it is Terastallized for the whole fight and is hit as its Tera type alone. Beaten, it leaves Tera Shards of that type and keeps its Tera type when caught.
raid_kind_alpha: An Alpha raid: it brings six of its kind back to its side at 3/4, 1/2 and 1/4 HP. Beaten, it waits with three perfect stats.
raid_kind_plain: A raid takes a party. Beaten, it waits in the overworld for whoever fought it.
raid_action_reopened: The party that went in did not come out. The lair is open again.
raid_action_empty: Nothing is standing here yet. Opening a lobby leaves it for anyone to join.

match.countPlural=one: A lobby is gathering — {count} team so far.
match.countPlural=*: A lobby is gathering — {count} teams so far.

raid_action_rejoin: Your party is still fighting in there.
raid_action_no_pokemon: You have no pokemon of your own to bring, so there is nothing to do here but watch.
raid_action_started: The raid has already started. Watching pays nothing.
raid_lair_summary: A lair, and whatever is standing in it.
raid_lair_quiet_toast: The lair is quiet. Somebody may have cleared it since you looked.
raid_lair_empty: A lair, and nothing in it just now.
raid_relic_spent: The relic is spent. Whatever this raid comes to, it comes to it once.
raid_notice_watch_only: You need a pokemon of your own to fight. You can only watch this one.
raid_notice_full: The lobby is full: {max} trainers are already in.
raid_notice_start: Start needs at least one team.
raid_join_failed: That team could not join: one of them may already be in another raid.
raid_start_failed: The raid could not be started.
raid_invite_description: They see the call above their list of raids, and joining answers it.
quest_turn_in_note: Taken from the bag when you claim.
quest_not_ready: That quest is not ready to claim.
quest_hint_rotation: {count} dailies refresh every day at midnight UTC, and one weekly hunt refreshes every Monday.
quest_hint_after: Only what you do after a daily or weekly starts counts toward it.
quest_hint_chains: Each chain below opens one step at a time, as you finish the one before.
quest_hint_claim: A finished quest waits for you to claim its reward.
profile_not_walked: They have not walked anywhere yet.
profile_dialog_description: Who this trainer is, who walks with them, and what they have done.
profile_sprite_none: Nothing to choose from yet. Beat a gym or a trainer class.
profile_sprite_note: Earned from badges, the Elite Four, and the trainer classes you have beaten. This is who you walk the world as.
profile_edit_description: What everybody else sees you as: the name on your lots and in a lobby, and the character standing beside it.
profile_nickname_hint: Letters, digits, spaces and ' . - are kept. {max} at most.
profile_title_hint: Earned from achievements and the badge ladder; worn under your name.
profile_team_save_failed: That team could not be saved.
profile_teams_hint_size: A team is up to {max} of your pokemon, saved under a name.
profile_teams_hint_load: Loading one in a raid or a duel fills the party with whichever of them can fight.
profile_no_teams: You have saved no teams yet.
profile_team_description: Name a party you can bring to a raid or a duel with one press.
profile_team_empty: You have nothing to put in a team.
profile_challenge_failed: They could not be called in — your lobby may already have two trainers in it.
award_summary_elite: {region}: {badges} of {badgeTotal} badges, {honors} of {honorTotal} of the Elite Four.
award_summary_champion: {region}: {badges} of {badgeTotal} badges, {honors} of {honorTotal} of the Elite Four, Champion.
